nodes.label: pysqlite3 Wheel Build Script
nodes.rationale: Builds a statically linked pysqlite3 0.5.3 wheel against the SQLite 3.46.1 amalgamation so Frigate is not bound to the base image's system SQLite (which varies across base images such as NVIDIA TensorRT). Fetches the pre-built amalgamation rather than compiling SQLite from source to save build time.

nodes.label: Vendored SQLite Amalgamation Strategy
nodes.rationale: Both the Python driver and the vector extension are compiled against a downloaded sqlite.org amalgamation zip rather than the distro libsqlite3, so behavior and feature flags are identical across every base image and architecture Frigate ships.

edges.source_location: sqlite-amalgamation-3460100.zip copied into pysqlite3 for a self-contained extension module
